ETOILE#0.note: Designed low-level nemesis (Adam, 2026-10-12): the AC 23 is the puzzle, not a mis-rating — a Tiny, dextrous composition the party must outsmart: restrain it and negate its Dex/size AC before trading blows. Fielded as a straight slugfest it is a whiff-fest.

FLESHRAKER (Knife Fiend)#0.note: Kept at CR 3 (Adam, 2026-10-12): where you see immunity to slashing and piercing, read VULNERABILITY TO BLUDGEONING — and ballistic is Tech Ranged PIERCING, so guns are likewise futile. The immunity-reliance IS the creature: the seemingly-unstoppable serial killer of an Urban Arcana Veiled-World hook, solved the moment someone picks up a club. The calculus above is its strategy snapshot.

LAMMASU#0.note: Trick for the GM's eye (Adam, 2026-10-12): Greater Invisibility 2/day (self only) — a POUNCE-AND-RAKE chassis that attacks from total unseen (50% miss against it, no Dex to AC, sneak-friendly flanks). The statline's quiet 'spells' undersells it: the lion you cannot see is the whole encounter.

PUPPETEER#1.note: Controller doctrine (Adam, 2026-10-12): Puppeteer CR 3; a PUPPET fights at the controlled creature's own CR. The composite runs about one band above the host alone: Enthrall is extraordinary contact-domination — dispel does nothing while the tendrils hold — the host's body shields the rider (Host Protection: saves as an attended item), and Hide Mind blanks divination. Freeing the host means pulling the rider, not winning an argument.

ROC#0.note: CR 10 = the kept 9 + the blanket MD stack (+1, Adam's privy ruling 2026-10-12). The keep's reasoning stands: simple strategies limit numbers abuses - a dumb animal with a big body, played artlessly by nature.

TARRASQUE#0.note: CR 21 = the kept 20 + the blanket MD stack (+1, Adam's privy ruling 2026-10-12). The body-gap keep stands: the body says 24; the CR assumes you can prepare. Flightless, rangeless, and dim — denied its charge it is a siege, met in the open it is an extinction. AMENDED: Burrow 10 ft. — it cannot be pinned, and the ground itself is its ambush lane; like an ancient dragon, it is thwarted or driven off, never casually eliminated (regeneration 40). FF letter banked.
